mapper.select: SELECT mkt05_share_id AS share_id , mkt05_parent_id AS parent_id , mkt05_share_cd AS share_code , mkt05_person_id AS person_id , mkt05_org_id AS org_id , f_cdnm('ShareCode', mkt05_share_cd, mkt05_company_id, f_today()) AS share_name , f_emp_kor_nm(mkt05_person_id) AS person_name , f_org_nm(mkt05_org_id, f_today()) AS org_name FROM mkt05_share WHERE mkt05_parent_id = #{parentId} AND mkt05_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT (SELECT CASE WHEN mkt05_share_cd = '1' THEN f_emp_kor_nm(mkt05_person_id) ELSE f_org_nm(mkt05_org_id, f_today()) END FROM mkt05_share WHERE mkt05_parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY mkt05_share_cd DESC LIMIT 1) ||(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '' ELSE ' 외 '|| (COUNT(*) - 1) END) FROM mkt05_share WHERE mkt05_parent_id = #{parentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mkt05_share ( mkt05_share_id, mkt05_parent_id, mkt05_share_cd, mkt05_person_id, mkt05_org_id, mkt05_company_id ) SELECT f_create_seq() , #{historyId} , mkt05_share_cd , mkt05_person_id , mkt05_org_id , mkt05_company_id FROM mkt05_share WHERE mkt05_parent_id = #{targetCompanyId} AND mkt05_company_id = #{companyId}

INSERT INTO mkt05_share ( mkt05_share_id, mkt05_parent_id, mkt05_share_cd, mkt05_person_id, mkt05_org_id, mkt05_company_id ) VALUES ( #{r.shareId}, #{parentId}, #{r.shareCode}, #{r.personId}, #{r.orgId}, #{companyId} )
